test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the incorrect sentence.

options.text: Ten percent of the students in the class speak three languages.
Forty-five minutes is a very long coffee break.
His advice was perfect for the situation.
The academic committee were undivided in their decision to hire the new staff.

solution:
**The correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**To identify the incorrect sentence, let's analyze the subject-verb agreement and noun usage in each option:**

__
 
• **Option 1: Ten percent of the students in the class speak three languages.**

 
 
• When a percentage is followed by a plural noun (students), it takes a plural verb (speak).
 
• This sentence is grammatically correct__.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Forty-five minutes is a very long coffee break.**
 __
 
• Units of time, money, and distance are treated as a single collective unit and take a singular verb.
 
• This sentence is grammatically correct__.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: His advice was perfect for the situation.**
 __
 
• "Advice" is an uncountable (mass) noun and must always be paired with a singular verb.
 
• This sentence is grammatically correct__.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The academic committee were undivided in their decision to hire the new staff.**
 __
 
• The sentence is erroneous__. A collective noun like "committee" takes a singular verb when the group acts as a single, unified entity. The use of the word "undivided" explicitly indicates that the group is acting as one unit.
 
• **The correct sentence would be:** "The academic committee **was** undivided in **its** decision to hire the new staff."
 
 
 
• __Therefore, out of the given options, only sentence 4 is grammatically incorrect__.
